privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains what personal data Timchenko Art collects when you use this site, how we use it, and what rights you have over your data.

sections.heading: Who is responsible for your data
sections.body: The controller of your personal data is the seller, the artist Marina (details on the “Legal Notice (Impressum)” page). Contact for data questions: maryna.timchenko.art@gmail.com.

sections.heading: What data we collect
sections.body: When you place an order, we collect your name, email address, phone number, and shipping address. If you write to us through the contact form, we receive your name, email address, and message. We do not store payment card details — these are handled exclusively by our payment partners (Stripe, PayPal, NOWPayments) under their own security policies.

sections.heading: How we use your data
sections.body: We use your data to process your order, communicate about shipping status, respond to your enquiries, and meet legal obligations, including tax record-keeping.

sections.heading: Sharing with third parties
sections.body: We share only the minimum necessary data with payment providers and shipping carriers — solely to fulfill your order. To run the site we also rely on service providers: Vercel (hosting), Supabase (database), Cloudflare (image delivery), Resend (order status emails), and EmailJS (contact form). Some of them may process data outside your country. We do not sell or share your data with advertising networks.

sections.heading: Cookies and local storage
sections.body: The site stores your selected language and currency in cookies, and your 18+ confirmation and the contents of your Easel in your browser's local storage. On your first visit, the country detected from your IP address is used only to pick an initial language and currency; we do not store the IP address itself. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies, or analytics. Payment pages are operated by Stripe, PayPal, and NOWPayments and are subject to their own policies.

sections.heading: How long we keep data
sections.body: We keep order data for as long as needed to fulfill your order and to meet accounting and tax record-keeping requirements. Messages sent through the contact form are kept only as long as needed to answer you and follow up.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: Under applicable data protection law (including GDPR for EU customers), you have the right to access, correct, and delete your personal data. EU residents may also lodge a complaint with their local data protection authority. Contact us at maryna.timchenko.art@gmail.com to exercise these rights.

termsOfService.title: Terms of Service
termsOfService.intro: These Terms govern your use of the Timchenko Art website and the purchase of paintings offered on it.

sections.heading: About this site
sections.body: This site is an online shop for original oil paintings. The seller and service provider is the artist Marina, who operates as a sole proprietor in Germany; her details are given on the “Legal Notice (Impressum)” page. The sales contract is concluded between you and the seller.

sections.heading: Order restrictions
sections.body: We do not accept or process orders from customers located in the Russian Federation, in line with our position on its ongoing armed aggression against Ukraine.

sections.heading: Paintings and uniqueness
sections.body: All paintings are made by hand by the artist, and each one is an original. A painting that is in stock goes to one buyer, and the artist can paint the same painting for you to order — that, too, is a hand-painted original (every canvas differs slightly). Exclusive paintings — made as individual commissions at an agreed price, and in-stock paintings withdrawn from sale for good by agreement with the buyer — are never repeated or printed. Any other painting in the gallery can also be ordered as a canvas print in the size of the original at a flat price of €300; for a print in a different size the price is agreed individually. It is the same image printed at a print shop, not a hand-painted work.

sections.heading: Appearance of the artworks
sections.body: Every painting is made by hand in oil on canvas, so colors on your screen may differ slightly from the actual work, and a painting made to order from an image on the site is an original in its own right and may differ slightly from the one shown.

sections.heading: Copyright
sections.body: All artworks, images, and texts on this site are protected by copyright and belong to the artist. Images on the site are previews for viewing only; copying, downloading, or any other use without written permission is prohibited. Buying a painting transfers ownership of the physical work, not its copyright or reproduction rights.

sections.heading: Pricing and payment
sections.body: Prices are set in euros (EUR). For convenience they may be displayed in your selected currency at an approximate rate, but payment is taken in euros: by card (including Apple Pay and Google Pay) or PayPal through Stripe, or by cryptocurrency through NOWPayments. Your bank or payment service may apply its own conversion and fees.

sections.heading: Age restriction
sections.body: This site is intended for adult visitors (18+), as some of the artwork shown may include nudity and erotic themes.

sections.heading: Governing law
sections.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Germany. Mandatory consumer protection rules of the country where you live remain unaffected.

shippingPolicy.title: Shipping Policy
shippingPolicy.intro: This page explains how we pack, ship, and track your order.

sections.heading: Processing time
sections.body: Paintings marked “Ready” are shipped within 5 business days of payment. Paintings the artist makes by hand to order (oil on canvas) take 15–30 days to complete after payment and are then shipped within 5 business days. You can see the current stage of your order on the “Order Status” page. A canvas print takes 5 days to produce and is then shipped within 5 business days. If an order contains items with different production times, it is shipped in one parcel once all items are ready, unless we agree otherwise with you.

sections.heading: Packaging
sections.body: Paintings are packed with their fragility in mind: rigid framing, protective corner guards, and moisture-resistant wrapping.

sections.heading: International shipping
sections.body: We ship to Ukraine, EU countries, Japan, and elsewhere, except the Russian Federation (see our Terms of Service). Customs duties and import taxes (where applicable) are the recipient's responsibility.

sections.heading: Order tracking
sections.body: You can follow your order — from payment to delivery — on the “Order Status” page, using the link in our emails or by entering your order number or tracking number. Once your order ships, you will also receive a tracking number by email.

returnsRefunds.title: Returns & Refunds
returnsRefunds.intro: This policy explains the terms for returning paintings and receiving refunds.

sections.heading: Gallery paintings and prints
sections.body: For paintings from the gallery — both ready-made (status “Ready” at the time of order) and painted to order — and for canvas prints in the standard size, returns are accepted within 14 days of the day you receive them, provided the item is in its original condition. Return shipping is paid by the customer who placed the order.

sections.heading: Custom commissions
sections.body: Paintings made to an individual commission (including exclusive paintings), as well as canvas prints in a non-standard size, are generally non-returnable given their personalized nature — except in cases of damage during shipping.

sections.heading: Damage in transit
sections.body: If your painting or print arrives damaged, contact us within 48 hours with photos of the damage — we'll arrange a replacement or a refund.

sections.heading: Refund amount and method
sections.body: A refund is 90% of the price of the painting or print; the remaining 10% covers the materials and production costs. Refunds go back via the payment method you used; for payments made in cryptocurrency, the refund is sent to the buyer's wallet.

sections.heading: How to request a return
sections.body: Email maryna.timchenko.art@gmail.com with your order number and the reason for the return. We'll respond within 1 business day.

sections.heading: Your statutory rights
sections.body: This policy does not limit the rights you have as a consumer under applicable law. If mandatory consumer law (including the right of withdrawal that applies to EU consumers) gives you greater rights than this policy, those rights prevail.

artistIntro.heading: Maryna Timchenko: Art That Crosses Boundaries
paragraphs: Marina Timchenko is a Ukrainian artist whose work is rooted in the energy of life, feeling, sensuality, and freedom. Born in Germany to a military family, she moved to Ukraine at the age of three. From childhood she studied painting, dance, sport, music, and photography, later earning a higher art education. Her artistic world was shaped at the intersection of painting, graphics, design, photography, and stage art — a mix that gives her work exceptional depth, rhythm, and a distinct vision of the human figure.

Before fully dedicating herself to painting, Marina worked as a photographer, designer, art director, model, and portrait artist. She painted portraits from childhood, and this became one of the foundations of her artistic voice. In 2015, oil paint found her heart, and from that moment art became her primary way of expressing the world, emotion, desire, vulnerability, and strength. In her paintings, eroticism, portraiture, landscape, and abstraction overlap — not as decorative imagery, but as a deep exploration of human nature, the body, the soul, and sensation.
To Marina, the human body is not just form, but history, emotion, desire, sensuality, and freedom.

In 2024, she held a solo exhibition in Karlsruhe, Germany, at DCS Contemporary gallery.
